patch_description: The prior constructor used five layered layouts, a common-radius continuation stage (`maxiter=550`), and equal-radius or low-radius final starts (`maxiter=1450`), followed by a long polish. This revision preserves that effective staged SLSQP structure but adds topology-aware unequal-radius starts after the common-radius stage. Each common-radius packing is converted into several strictly feasible heterogeneous radius vectors: circles with more interior clearance are initially larger, while boundary and alternating-layer circles are slightly smaller. The perturbation amplitude is deliberately limited (`8%`) and globally buffered (`0.90*q`) so starts remain feasible without relying on solver recovery. This helps SLSQP enter asymmetric unequal-radius contact graphs directly rather than first converging through a rigid symmetric basin. The search also uses deterministic mirrored/phase-shifted profiles, refined common-stage tolerance, and a final high-accuracy polish of the best basin.
